extracted.intended_audience: Museums, libraries, and related organizations seeking IMLS grant funding (prospective applicants)
extracted.subtask_description: Finding and following IMLS Notices of Funding Opportunities (NOFOs) for FY26 and complying with procedural requirements (timing and correct application forms) when preparing grant applications to IMLS programs.

rubrics_metrics.name: NOFO availability timeframe
rubrics_metrics.description: Application forms and Notices of Funding Opportunities (Grant Program Guidelines) for the current fiscal year are made available approximately 30-90 days before the grant deadline.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this timeframe to plan application preparation; earlier (previous-year) guidelines may be available only for reference until the current FY materials are posted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use current fiscal year application
rubrics_metrics.description: Until that time, applications and guidelines from the previous year are available for your reference, but you must use the current fiscal year application when you apply.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not submit an application using previous-year forms or guidelines — ensure you download and complete the current fiscal year NOFO/application before submission.
